memories.author: D05
memories.text: Hypothyroidism, benign positional vertigo, vitamin B12 deficiency. Patient reports fatigue, weight gain, occasional dizziness on turning head, and mild tingling in extremities. On exam: mild dry skin, normal vitals, positional nystagmus positive on Dix-Hallpike right side, thyroid not enlarged. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.60 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.79; unchanged from baseline. Smoking: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

memories.text: Hypothyroidism, benign positional vertigo, vitamin B12 deficiency. Patient notes improved energy, less frequent dizzy spells, occasional mild nausea. Exam: no goiter, Dix-Hallpike negative bilaterally, mild peripheral neuropathy unchanged. Spirometry: FEV1 2.88 L (93% pred), FVC 3.62 L (96% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.80; ΔFEV1 +0.03 L. Smoking: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.
